description:
Controlled repro of ISS-012 stuck-EXPORTING using T-036 renderer logs. Classify which decision-tree branch fires.

**Prior evidence (2026-05-23):** Run-01 and run-02 observed ISS-015-style interception under Screen source — SAVING→RECORDING with null snapshot ID. T-037 was gated on window-source attempts because ISS-015 intercepted all Screen-source saves before EXPORTING could be reached.

**Constraint update (2026-05-24, ISS-015 resolved):** ISS-015 is now fixed by T-043 (overlap-window eviction predicate). T-044 confirms replay.save consistently reaches EXPORTING under Screen/monitor source. The window-source-required gate is LIFTED — Screen/monitor source is acceptable for ISS-012 classification. The prior window-source constraint was an ISS-015 workaround, not an ISS-012 requirement.

**Preserved prior conclusion:** ISS-015 classification (T-038: rolling-buffer seal failure / T-042: overlap-eviction root cause) is correct and unaffected by resuming T-037.

**Qualifying conditions for ISS-012 repro (updated):** Session must have run for >5 min before the save attempt (to ensure multiple segment commits under dedup conditions). Replay buffer window size (30s or other) is independent of this condition. Screen/monitor source, portal active, XR24 SHM path acceptable. Multiple sequential saves required. Watch for: valid MP4 on disk + export.completed path fired + renderer remains stuck in v2State=EXPORTING + controls disabled after 100%.

**T-036 [export lifecycle] diagnostics are deployed** and will classify on next repro. Repro rate: 1/10+ cumulative (1 historical repro, 9 post-fix clean saves). Low-rate; mixed-motion content may be needed to reproduce original VAL-CAP-006 conditions.
title: ISS-012 stuck-EXPORTING controlled repro + boundary classification
